title: Bounded native arrangement and SQL assurance comparison
question: Can the existing PgAdmin shared route preserve current deployment and isolation while private pg_virtualenv supplies a credible comparison, and what native assurance tools warrant adoption?
method: Direct existing PgAdmin acquisition on unique owned databases, without general sweeps or shared authentication changes; private pg_virtualenv under an owned TMPDIR parent with explicit sockets/preloads/durability and actual purpose logins; controlled outer SIGKILL before/after server startup with supervised exact-root settlement; private Python/pgTAP posture comparison and pg_prove positive/negative controls; tagged plugin and installed tooling source comparison.

inputs.role: bounded native contract and SQL assurance source
private containment and supervised settlement source

outputs.role: passing results, failed attempts and source context

results.name: serialized shared current deployment and owned clone controls
private current deployment and owned clone controls
private outer death before server startup and after startup
pg_prove positive and deliberate wrong-SQLSTATE rejection

conclusion: Retain PgAdmin shared-cluster deployment and inner clone ownership under ADR-0032; extend its authentication-effect recovery as separately implemented TA-02. Private pg_virtualenv is feasible but adds an outer lifecycle and explicit configuration adaptation, and its process group does not own the daemonized server; no default adoption. pytest-postgresql default janitor terminates connections and is unsuitable for shared disposal; an additional server pilot would not change this selected within-contract route. pgTAP can discriminate posture and exact errors; pg_prove correctly fails deliberate TAP failure despite successful SQL execution. Keep Python/native controls now; optional narrower adoption belongs to actual assertion consumers. The pilot does not establish production next-invocation/live-owner recovery, all startup-death windows, host-crash durability, elapsed-time benefit or full TA01-04/product qualification. Failed probe-query/VALUES attempts and overlapping shared capacity failure remain retained.
